title: Gosok Bak Minum Dulu
subject: a Komodo keeper at Surabaya Zoo and the man who signs up as a Sunday volunteer because of her; she makes him scrub the water trough every Sunday for a month before she lets him hold the feeding pole
caption: Retro sweet soul in the current Surabaya revival style, late-60s Motown and Northern Soul filtered through Indonesian pop. A reverb-drenched, surf-tinged clean electric guitar playing tremolo arpeggios; a Hammond organ with slow Leslie swirl holding the chords; a two-piece horn section, trumpet and tenor sax, answering the vocal with short Motown stabs; a round fingered electric bass walking under live drums with a tambourine on the backbeat. Warm analog tape sound, mono-leaning drums, spring reverb on the guitar. Female alto lead, smooth and unhurried with a slight smoky grain, intimate in the verses and fuller in the chorus, sparse doo-wop backing oohs. 86 BPM, F major. Warm, teasing and quietly delighted. No modern R&B runs, no autotune, no trap drums, no city-pop synths, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - reverb guitar and organ, horn pickup]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pagi kamu datang pakai kaus relawan
Ukurannya kebesaran, namamu ditulis spidol
Katamu cinta binatang, matamu lihat aku
Kukasih sikat kawat sama ember yang bocor

[Pre-Chorus]
Di balik pagar si Rangga cuma melirik pelan
Kamu pura-pura berani, lututmu gemetaran

[Chorus]
Gosok bak minum dulu, Mas
Sampai lumutnya hilang
Galah pakan bukan buat yang baru datang
Minggu depan kita lihat lagi

[Verse 2]
Minggu kedua kamu bawa sikat sendiri
Minggu ketiga bawa es teh dua bungkus
Kebun Binatang Surabaya panas jam sebelas
Bajumu basah, kamu masih senyum terus

[Pre-Chorus]
Pengunjung kira kamu pegawai paling rajin
Cuma aku yang tahu kamu ke sini buat siapa

[Chorus]
Gosok bak minum dulu, Mas
Sampai airnya bening
Galah pakan bukan buat yang baru datang
Tapi kamu belum juga pergi

[Bridge - organ and horns, half-time]
Minggu keempat baknya mengilap kayak kaca
Kuserahkan galahnya, tanganku ikut di sana

[Chorus]
Pegang galahnya pelan, Mas
Jangan lihat aku, lihat dia
Habis ini kamu boleh tanya nomorku
Sikatnya simpan buat minggu depan

[Outro - horns and tambourine, guitar tremolo fading]
